name: Sandeep Kumar
title: Senior Software Engineer
headline: NODE.JS | NESTJS | REACT.JS | TYPESCRIPT | POSTGRESQL | AWS
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building fintech and lending platforms end to end with Node.js, NestJS, React.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Led greenfield delivery of a multi-product trade finance suite.

experience.companySummary: Global trade and invoice finance platform for exporters, importers, and investors.
highlights: Led end-to-end design and development of a multi-product fintech platform suite from scratch, architecting 7 production-grade frontend and backend repositories using NestJS, Express, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
Built the Broker Portal covering RM referral-based agent registration, onboarding, KYC, agreement lifecycle, lead generation, commission tracking, and e-wallet withdrawals.

Developed the Investor Portal for portfolio tracking, invoice-level exposure, ROI monitoring, and wallet transactions, and the Reporting Portal giving internal teams and RMs centralized dashboards for deals, business metrics, and portfolio performance.
Built reusable backend services and shared APIs for onboarding, KYC, agreement workflows, wallet transactions, investor operations, and reporting.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas, entity relationships, and role-based workflow logic across broker, investor, reporting, wallet, and commission domains.
Developed responsive React frontends with modular architecture, reusable components, and scalable query/state management.

experience.companySummary: Online lending platform funding small businesses across the US.
highlights: Designed and implemented automation workflows for third-party report pulling, verifier-based application routing, and early-stage loan rejection, significantly reducing manual effort and improving processing efficiency.
Built secure microservices and REST APIs with encryption-based inter-service communication for internal lending workflows.
Developed a scalable document management system with pre-signed S3 uploads, ZIP extraction, structured storage, and document processing flows.
Built AI-powered lending document workflows using Amazon Textract and Bedrock to extract, classify, and process lending documents from a single upload.
Improved system throughput and reliability by integrating FIFO and Standard SQS queues, caching strategies, and CI/CD pipelines.
Reduced API response times from 6 minutes to 1–2 minutes through asynchronous service design and performance-focused backend optimization.
Integrated external APIs and built cloud-native business modules supporting loan processing and reporting workflows.
Customized finance automation in NetSuite using SuiteScript and Restlets for journal entries and data synchronization.
Led a cross-functional team of 4 developers, conducted code reviews, and ensured quality, delivery, and maintainable engineering practices.

experience.companySummary: B2B GPS tracking, attendance, and video surveillance platform.
highlights: Developed core modules for payroll, invoicing, attendance, employee tracking, and resource allocation in a B2B GPS tracking platform.
Built high-performance Node.js APIs and PL/v8 PostgreSQL functions for large-scale data operations and business workflows.
Automated bulk data uploads through Excel-based processing and integrated third-party APIs to synchronize partner and employee records.
Created Linux services and cron-based schedulers for nightly data syncs and background processing.
Implemented real-time data replication across distributed environments using custom synchronization protocols.
Added unit testing and backend quality checks to strengthen stability across server-client interactions.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams on feature delivery, backend architecture planning, and production issue resolution.
